newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar gently firmer on spread buying.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar gently firmer on spread buying.

text.p: Light spread buying pushed London's spot May white sugar contract gently higher in light activity on Thursday but the nearby ranges still remained tight.

Commission and trade players were mentioned as leading the thin volume, pushing May/August out to around 40 cents after it fluctuated between a slight premium and discount throughout Wednesday's session.
At 1245 GMT May was 90 cents higher at $307.00 and August up by the same amount at $307.10. Volume reached a light 423 lots.
"It's a bit dull at the moment," said one trader, adding that interest was likely to pick up in the London market after the New York March expiry on Friday.
Technically, May has regained ground lost during Wednesday's session when values briefly broke through an upward trendline dating from mid-January.
Analysts said the position had also bounced back after sliding to a 50-percent retracement level and was now targetting $309.50 as the next resistance point.
Iraq has rescheduled its tender to buy sugar under the auspices of the U.N. oil-for-food deal to March 7, although the exact amount required is still unclear.
Bangladesh tendered to buy 12,500 tonnes of white sugar with offers to be submitted on March 1. Specified shipment dates are March 11/April 11.
Paris positions were also firmer but Matif volume stayed on the light side at just 162 lots.
May was up $1.20at $307.20 and August up $1.10 at $307.00.
